name: Release 0.2.12
body:
## What's Changed
* Add support for MSR_IA32_BIOS_SIGN_ID by @P467121 in https://github.com/namazso/PawnIO.Modules/pull/121
* IntelMSR: allow reading MSR_SECONDARY_TURBO_RATIO_LIMIT by @ObnubiladO in https://github.com/namazso/PawnIO.Modules/pull/109
* Add legacy PC speaker. by @namazso in https://github.com/namazso/PawnIO.Modules/pull/126
* Allow writes to IA32_TEMPERATURE_TARGET (0x1A2) by @Marki4175 in https://github.com/namazso/PawnIO.Modules/pull/140
* Add RadeonSMU module by @miklebel in https://github.com/namazso/PawnIO.Modules/pull/110
* Add AppleT2Smc module: Apple T2 SMC over MMIO by @golirt1 in https://github.com/namazso/PawnIO.Modules/pull/71
* Add read-only Xiaomi TM2424 fan tachometer module by @Xiaofeng-used in https://github.com/namazso/PawnIO.Modules/pull/94
* Add LpcThinkpadEC: ThinkPad 0x1600 EC window by @mews-se in https://github.com/namazso/PawnIO.Modules/pull/105
* IntelMSR: allow reading limit-reason MSRs and writing ratio-limit MSRs by @asto18089 in https://github.com/namazso/PawnIO.Modules/pull/127

## New Contributors
* @P467121 made their first contribution in https://github.com/namazso/PawnIO.Modules/pull/121
* @ObnubiladO made their first contribution in https://github.com/namazso/PawnIO.Modules/pull/109
* @miklebel made their first contribution in https://github.com/namazso/PawnIO.Modules/pull/110
* @golirt1 made their first contribution in https://github.com/namazso/PawnIO.Modules/pull/71
* @Xiaofeng-used made their first contribution in https://github.com/namazso/PawnIO.Modules/pull/94
* @mews-se made their first contribution in https://github.com/namazso/PawnIO.Modules/pull/105
* @asto18089 made their first contribution in https://github.com/namazso/PawnIO.Modules/pull/127

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/namazso/PawnIO.Modules/compare/0.2.11...0.2.12
